# A 2759 cap in PG(10,3).
# Quantavane, November 2026: found from Edel's 2744-cap in PG(10,3) (yvesedel.de, Matritzen/CAPs), in its
# coordinates; 2718 of its points are kept (26 removed) and 41 points are new.
# The 2759 points are the columns of this 11 x 2759 matrix over GF(3), one row per coordinate x0, ..., x10;
# it is a check matrix of a linear [2759,2748,4]_3 code.
# Field: GF(3), the integers modulo 3, written 0, 1, 2.
# Columns: every point is scaled so that its last nonzero coordinate is 1. Columns 1-2718 are the points of
# Edel's cap that are kept, columns 2719-2759 the new points, each group in lexicographic order of (x0, ..., x10).
